mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the visual pathways was most worthwhile: the distinction between light entering the eye and nerve signals leaving it clarified what the eye contributes to seeing.

leastWorthwhile.text: The individual front fittings felt repetitive because each worked as expected and the available order had no apparent consequence.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it connected the assembled parts to a new action or question. The explanations were useful, but the mostly predictable fitting steps offered few meaningful decisions.
